title: In-memory SQLite for unit tests is correct choice
description: sqlite::memory: for unit tests avoids temp file cleanup, is fast, and is isolated per test. The max_connections(1) in tests is required because with SQLite in-memory mode, each connection gets its own independent database — multiple connections would each see an empty database. A future contributor might increase max_connections to speed up tests; don't — it would silently break the tests.
